label: class_e_08_question_01
text:
1. Which cheer boosts Attack and Sp. Atk for all
    allies during a Tera Raid Battle?

A) Go all out!
B) Go all in!
C) Out we go!

label: class_e_08_question_02
text:
2. What do we call the battles that Pokémon sent
    out with the R Button do on their own?

A) You-Can-Do-It Battles
B) Auto Fights
C) Auto Battles

label: class_e_08_question_03
text:
3. How should you obtain LP?

A) Take on Gyms
B) Exchange materials
C) Hack the system

label: class_e_08_question_04
text:
4. High-level Pokémon are adjusted to what level
    when using Flat Rules in Link Battles?

A) Lv. 50
B) Lv. 60
C) Lv. 100

label: class_e_08_question_05
text:
5. When using Normal Rules in Link Battles, you
    can use multiple Pokémon of the same species
    and multiples of the same held item.

A) True
B) False

label: class_e_08_battle_03
text: Time’s up! Put your pencils down![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_08_battle_04
text: I saw you giving it everything you’ve got! I’m sure\nyou’ll all get perfect scores![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_08_battle_05
text: You all did so well in my class! If you pass this\ntest, you’ll officially be battle masters![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_08_battle_06
text: Now go ask for your surely stellar scores at the\nfront desk, you little rascals![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
